adjudication.rationale: The diff shows multiple calls to `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "<literal>", credential.userId)` using hand-typed slug strings (e.g. `"msteams"` in `packages/app-store/office365video/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts`, `"google-calendar"`, `"lark-calendar"`, `"office365-calendar"`, etc.). The newly added webhook endpoint (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`) maps credentials based on `app.slug` via `appStoreMetadata[app.slug]`, so keeping slugs consistent across the system matters. While the diff does not prove any of these literals are currently wrong, it does introduce/expand a maintainability risk: slugs can drift from each app’s canonical slug source (often `config.json`/metadata) and then the sync endpoint could be called with a different slug than the one used internally for credential storage/webhook handling.
